MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful addition because a larger screen could give me convenient smart-home controls alongside my cameras.",
    "The Blink recommendations connect with my existing Blink camera and interest in home security, so they feel relevant even though I do not currently need more cameras."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Fire TV sticks duplicate functions I already have through my 4K stick and Fire TV television; an HD stick gives me even less reason to switch.",
    "Voice-only Echo speakers add little when my remote already provides Alexa access, and a smart plug does not help without an appliance I want to automate.",
    "A whole-home security bundle or three-camera pack requires a specific coverage need that I have not identified."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to be taken as a reason to recommend more streaming devices, even when those purchases have already met that need.",
    "Sharing Alexa or Blink compatibility seems to count too heavily without enough attention to what each device would actually add to my setup."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about adding a useful capability to equipment I already have, which makes a camera-related display more appealing than another streaming stick or voice-only speaker.",
    "Interest does not always mean I would buy now: I prefer the larger Show 8 over the Show 5, and additional cameras need specific places to use them."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my connected-home interests but often mistake equipment I already own for an unmet need."
}
